default_material: Cast resin with hand-painted opaque color and selective translucent inserts
finish: Satin body paint; gloss gems, glass, metallic trim, and translucent effects

pawns.name: Crooked Crown
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin; gloss jewel accents
notes: Keep crown points and gold finials at least 1.5 mm thick.
Cast crown and base as one balanced piece.
Raise gem settings enough for clean paint separation.

pawns.name: Golden Dumpster
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin; metallic and satin paint
notes: Fix the lid at roughly 20 degrees with two broad hinges.
Integrate side handles into the body wall.
Graffiti is painted shape work with no readable lettering.

pawns.name: Dab Valley Rig
pawns.material: Translucent emerald, ruby, fuchsia, and aqua resin with opaque gold trim
notes: Exactly one mouthpiece and one quartz-banger opening; seal every other surface.
Support the large heart at two broad contacts and keep all tubes at least 2 mm thick.
Cast a solid top cap; key translucent heart inserts securely into the main body.

pawns.name: Midnight Express
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin; metallic trim and satin body paint
notes: Fuse wheels, pipes, and track directly into the body and base.
Keep exposed pipes at least 1.5 mm thick.
Maintain the compact length so it fits standard board spaces.

pawns.name: Area 52 Saucer
pawns.material: Opaque silver resin shell with translucent cyan beam and violet dome
notes: Use the translucent tractor beam as the load-bearing support.
Round antenna tips and keep shafts at least 1.5 mm thick.
Permanently join saucer, beam, terrain, and base.

pawns.name: Hotel Diablo Bell
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin; gloss crimson shell and metallic trim
notes: Join both horns fully to the bell shell and round their tips.
Use a broad fixed push button rather than a moving part.
Keep gold scrollwork as raised paint-friendly relief.

pawns.name: Wrong Turn Sign
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin; weathered satin paint and metallic trim
notes: Keep the sign plate at least 2 mm and the post at least 3 mm thick.
Anchor the post through the sculpted rocks into the base.
Round and connect all crystal clusters to avoid sharp break points.

pawns.name: Fortune Key
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin; gloss jewels, enamel colors, and metallic gold
notes: Keep the key shaft at least 3 mm thick.
Use the rear filigree as a hidden brace from bow to base.
Separate raised gold borders cleanly for paint masking.

pawns.name: Fortune Penguin
pawns.material: Opaque cast resin penguin with translucent turquoise ice terrain
notes: Thicken both flippers and the lifted foot to at least 2.5 mm.
Key the standing foot and tail area firmly into the ice terrain.
Round all ice tips and keep the center of gravity over the base.
